# Missing destination fixtures

The source is the native nonmatching-registration allowance in the
[session editor contract](../contract.md), including its nonaliasing requirement,
and the strict registration schema and framed key in
[invitation storage](../../../invitation/starter/storage.md).

The additive external fixture was authored independently of either implementation.
It constructs complete registrations from those public definitions, standard
SHA256 over literal plan bytes, canonical base64 and actual native root identity.
Neither product output nor a builder's private helper supplies the expected value.

Jules and jules are distinct exact account identities. The fixture establishes
whether their account directories actually share a native device/inode before
removing only the test-owned empty directory. Both missing tails must still
refuse before identity, in either spelling order. Only actual opposite-case
ENOENT permits the named unsupported-alias-profile skip; other inspection or
security failures fail the fixture.

The positive control creates first-person and second-person directories under
one native parent, establishes that their native objects are distinct, then
removes both owned empty directories. A literal selected answer must still save.
Complete native snapshots, exact record bytes, input consumption and clock counts
judge the result. Registrations and unrelated paths remain preserved and private.

Test-owned creation and removal establish fixture premises. They do not authorize
the product to create filesystem probe objects before consent, assume Unicode
collation or treat a capability skip as demonstrated case-alias coverage.
